name: Destined To Be
overview: To honor a long-standing family pact, Adia Nordstrom takes her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to the cold and enigmatic Stefan Vaughn. Struggling to accept her shattered dreams and distant husband, Adia gradually discovers unexpected feelings beneath their reluctant union. As secrets emerge and their bond deepens, the return of Adia’s former love threatens to unravel everything. Caught between duty, loyalty, and the possibility of true love, Adia must decide whether to hold on to the past or embrace an unexpected future.
